name: How do fire restoration companies remove persistent smoke odors?

mainEntity.name: How do fire restoration companies remove persistent smoke odors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing persistent smoke odors is a specialized process that goes beyond surface cleaning. Restoration companies use a combination of techniques, including thorough cleaning of all affected surfaces to remove soot particles that trap odors. They may then employ professional-grade air scrubbers, ozone generators (used in uninhabited areas), thermal foggers, and hydroxyl generators to neutralize odor molecules at a molecular level. These methods penetrate porous materials and the air to eliminate, not just mask, the smell of smoke.
